meta.description: Runs JACKS (Joint Analysis of CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout Screens; Allen et al 2019 Genome Research), modeling per-sgRNA log-fold-change as gene-essentiality times guide-efficacy, with hierarchical efficacy priors shared across screens using the same library.

scientific_integrity.detail: Citations (Allen 2019 Genome Research 29:464; Behan 2019 Nature 568:511; Meyers 2017 Nat Genet 49:1779) are real and correctly attributed, unchanged from the pre-fix audit. No fabricated statistics found; every quantitative claim checked in this round (iteration cap 50, n_pseudo Python default 0 vs CLI default 2000, apply_w_hp default False, run_JACKS.py location) was independently confirmed against the installed JACKS 0.2 source, not just re-read from the fix log.

practice_boundaries.detail: Purely computational gene-essentiality tooling; no diagnostic, prescriptive, or patient-facing content.

methodological_ground.detail: No statistical fallacy found. The Model section's stated priors (Normal(1,1) efficacy, Normal(0,1e4) gene effect, tau_prior_strength=0.5) were checked directly against jacks.infer.inferJACKSGene's default keyword arguments and match exactly.

code_usability.detail: Unlike the pre-fix 'borderline' PASS, both previously-crashing code artifacts now run cleanly: examples/run_jacks.py's analyze_results() (P0: NameError on output_prefix) and SKILL.md's own efficacy_summary() (P0: KeyError('Gene')) were re-executed against real JACKS output in this audit and both completed without error, including the documented ValueError guardrail on an unmapped guide.

functional_suitability.note: Both P0 fixes (efficacy_summary join, analyze_results output_prefix parameter) and all five P1/P2 factual corrections (run_JACKS.py location, apply_w_hp default, wrong-library-prior symptom, naming-mismatch symptom, iteration cap) independently re-verified correct by direct execution. Docked one point: usage-guide.md's 'What the Agent Will Do' step 12 still lists generic output filenames (gene_results.txt, sgrna_efficacy.txt, library_redesign_candidates.txt, comparison_with_mageck.txt) that match none of the real JACKS output files documented and produced elsewhere in the same Skill -- a new finding, not addressed by the round-2 fix pass.

reliability.note: Both shipped code artifacts that crashed on first real use pre-fix now run correctly and produce correct output; the guidemap-join guard (efficacy_summary) raises an actionable ValueError on unmapped guides, confirmed by direct execution. The hyperparameter-override recipe restores exact prior state after use, verified by object identity plus a byte-identical follow-up run.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md grew from 269 to 305 lines to accommodate the fixes -- still well under the 500-line budget and information-dense rather than bloated; usage-guide.md and examples/ keep secondary detail out of the core file.

agent_usability.note: Every internal self-contradiction identified in the pre-fix audit (apply_w_hp default vs recommendation, X1/X2 gene-file-vs-guide-file confusion, 5000+ vs 50 iteration claims) is now consistent across SKILL.md, usage-guide.md and examples/run_jacks.py -- confirmed by reading all three files together, not just SKILL.md in isolation.

human_usability.note: Clear When-to/When-not-to-use and Tips sections; the Scene Override 2 principle (strict validation over silent auto-correction) is correctly implemented -- efficacy_summary() raises rather than guessing on an unmapped guide.

security.note: No credential exposure or injection vectors; the one subprocess call remains list-form, not shell=True. run_jacks_analysis()'s file-path arguments are still passed to subprocess without existence/type validation (pre-existing, low risk given list-form invocation).

maintainability.note: 3-file surface, now internally consistent. The file-location contradiction and the two real runtime bugs that made this hard to maintain pre-fix are fixed and independently confirmed resolved.

agent_specific.note: Composability (Related Skills cross-links) and escape hatches (When JACKS Is Not the Right Tool) remain strong. Idempotency, previously only disclosed as a limitation, is now positively demonstrated: two identical runs produced byte-identical gene and guide-efficacy files, and the override-then-restore pattern was verified to leave no residual state change.

inputs.label: Multi-screen joint analysis on JACKS' own bundled Project Score example-small data (5 AML cell lines vs plasmid control, 8081 guides, 1579 genes) -- regression of the apply_w_hp default fix
inputs.note: Ran SKILL.md's literal post-fix canonical example (apply_w_hp=False, 9.5s) and the 'deliberate use only' variant (apply_w_hp=True, 12.5s). The canonical example is now internally consistent with its own stated recommendation (pre-fix it set True against its own advice). Per-cell-line Spearman rho between settings: 0.894-0.960 -- confirms the two settings produce materially different rankings, though the exact numeric range differs from SKILL.md's quoted 0.75-0.89 because that figure is explicitly scoped to the full 13-cell-line 'example' dataset, not the faster 'example-small' (5-cell-line) dataset used here for speed.

inputs.label: CRISPRi chemistry-mismatch hyperparameter-override recipe, run end-to-end with verified restoration
inputs.note: Pre-fix this Failure Mode's fix was an unactionable P1 (no runnable interface documented). Post-fix, the functools.partial(jacks.infer.inferJACKSGene, ...) recipe runs to completion, measurably widens the efficacy posterior SD (0.557 -> 0.763, confirming the override actually takes effect rather than being silently ignored), and correctly restores the original function afterward -- verified both by object identity and a follow-up run that reproduced the original default-prior output byte-for-byte.

inputs.label: Determinism, iteration cap, and Python-API p-value default -- new inputs beyond the pre-fix audit
inputs.note: New input, not in the pre-fix audit. Regression-tests the three 'found while fixing' internal contradictions: (1) gene effect and guide efficacy files were byte-for-byte identical across two independent reruns on identical input, confirming the corrected determinism claim; (2) the installed JACKS 0.2's inferJACKS default n_iter=50 matches SKILL.md's Quantitative Thresholds table, and the documented n_iter=500 override recipe ran to completion and was correctly restored; (3) supplying ctrl_genes with the Python API's n_pseudo left at its default (0) produced no p-value file, while n_pseudo=2000 did -- confirming the corrected note that the Python default differs from the CLI default. Also surfaces one new, unfixed finding: usage-guide.md's own listed output filenames do not match the Skill's real output.

key_strengths: Both P0 crashes (efficacy_summary() KeyError, analyze_results() NameError) are fixed and independently confirmed running against real JACKS output, including the documented ValueError guardrail on guide-map mismatches.

All corrected factual claims (run_JACKS.py location, apply_w_hp default/recommendation match, 50-iteration cap, full determinism of gene effects, Python-API n_pseudo default requiring an explicit override for p-values, naming-mismatch and wrong-library-prior symptoms) were independently re-verified against the installed JACKS 0.2 API and real data in this audit, not accepted from the fix log.

The CRISPRi hyperparameter-override recipe, previously an unactionable P1 finding, now runs end-to-end, measurably changes inference (efficacy posterior SD widened from 0.557 to 0.763 as expected), and correctly restores the default afterward -- verified by object identity plus a byte-identical follow-up run.

Every internal self-contradiction found during the fix pass (apply_w_hp, gene-file-vs-guide-file X1/X2 columns, iteration-count claims) is now consistent across SKILL.md, usage-guide.md, and examples/run_jacks.py.

recommendations.title: usage-guide.md's documented output filenames don't match real JACKS output
recommendations.problem: 'What the Agent Will Do' step 12 lists gene_results.txt, sgrna_efficacy.txt, library_redesign_candidates.txt, comparison_with_mageck.txt as outputs, but no code anywhere in the Skill produces files with these names -- the real JACKS outputs (confirmed by every execution in this audit) are <outprefix>_gene_JACKS_results.txt, _gene_std_JACKS_results.txt, _grna_JACKS_results.txt, optionally _gene_pval_JACKS_results.txt, and a .pickle file.
recommendations.root_cause: Appears to be a leftover generic/aspirational output summary written before the Skill's real JACKS-derived filename conventions were pinned down elsewhere; not in scope for the round-2 fix pass, which targeted verified code and factual-claim defects rather than this workflow-summary line.
recommendations.fix: Replace step 12's filename list with the Skill's own real output filenames, or explicitly label library_redesign_candidates.txt and comparison_with_mageck.txt as agent-authored downstream summaries rather than direct JACKS outputs.
